tools.name: search_watches
tools.description: Searches current watch listings and shows them as photo cards. Use it when someone wants to find, browse or buy a watch. Knows trade nicknames and which years each one existed, so a request for a year that did not exist returns the closest real watch with an explanation.

tools.name: open_storefront
tools.description: Shows the Watches in Stock storefront: new arrivals, our own stock, leading brands and example questions. Use it when someone wants to browse, asks what is new or what is available, or has not named a watch yet.

tools.name: market_report
tools.description: Shows analytics for a watch: where asking prices sit, prices by year and by what is included, new listings each day, price history when there is enough, a price checker and background on the model. Use it for questions about value, trends or whether a price is fair. Based on dealer asking prices fro

tools.name: suggest_watches
tools.description: Suggests nicknames, references and models, with photos, for the store search box.

tools.name: explore_brand
tools.description: Shows a brand's main models as a guide: what each is, who it suits, its style, and how many are listed now with typical prices. Use it when someone knows the brand but not the model, is buying a gift, or asks for help choosing. Covers Patek Philippe, Rolex and Audemars Piguet.

tools.name: compare_watches
tools.description: Shows two to four listings side by side with their prices and details. Use it when someone wants to choose between specific listings.

tools.name: get_watch
tools.description: Shows one listing in detail, with its photo, parsed facts and the dealer description. Use it when someone asks about a specific watch from search_watches.

tools.name: get_specialist_link
tools.description: Looks up which Watches in Stock specialist handles a listing and returns a WhatsApp link with a draft note. It only returns a link: nothing is sent, ordered, reserved or paid for. Use it when someone wants to talk to a specialist about a listing.

tools.name: get_sourcing_link
tools.description: For a watch that is not listed, or not listed the way the customer wants it. Returns a WhatsApp link to a Watches in Stock specialist with a draft note describing what they want. It only returns a link: nothing is sent, ordered, reserved or paid for.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Says whether listings are still on watchesinstock.com. Use it when someone asks if a watch from earlier is still there. A listing can sell at any time, so a specialist has the final word.

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: Gives what Watches in Stock has published about itself: authenticity, how prices are set, availability, buying, selling, consignment, where listings come from, and shipping, returns, warranty and payment. Use it for questions about the business rather than a particular watch.

tools.name: identify_watch
tools.description: Explains a watch nickname or reference: which references it covers, what they look like and which years they were made. Use it for questions such as "what is a Bruce Wayne?".

tools.name: price_check
tools.description: Gives the low, median and high asking price from current listings for a watch. Use it for questions such as "what does a 2021 Batgirl go for?".
